answer: Each agent locks 1,000 units of rare quartz to reserve a unique vine slot, forming a bond where a sponsor assumes liability for misconduct. An honest participant pays 1,000, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000, creating a massive cost gale for sybil farms. A verifier checks for quartz reuse via cross-ref, flagging any vine-based proxy. A gale of evidence triggers a 30-day lock forfeiture if the verifier detects collusion.
